promptText: When an owner wants a collection or soft-brand option for a hotel conversion in Mexico, which brands are commonly considered?
rawResponse:
When a hotel owner in Mexico is seeking to convert an existing property into a “collection” or soft‑brand arrangement—preserving its unique character while gaining access to global distribution and loyalty programs—several internationally recognized soft-brand options are commonly considered:

• Marriott International:  
  – Autograph Collection – an upscale to upper-upscale soft brand launched in 2010, ideal for distinct, independent hotels ([hospitality.today](https://www.hospitality.today/article/marriotts-soft-brands-are-a-distribution-strategy-not-a-brand-strategy?utm_source=openai)).  
  – Tribute Portfolio – a lifestyle-oriented soft brand inherited from Starwood, positioned slightly more flexibly than Autograph for creative, independent hotels ([hospitality.today](https://www.hospitality.today/article/marriotts-soft-brands-are-a-distribution-strategy-not-a-brand-strategy?utm_source=openai)).  
  – Design Hotels – also from Starwood, focusing on design-led, boutique-luxury properties ([hoteldevelopmentguide.com](https://hoteldevelopmentguide.com/hotel-brands/?utm_source=openai)).  
  – The Luxury Collection – the highest tier among Marriott’s soft brands, emphasizing grand, historic, or upscale converted properties ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marriott_International?utm_source=openai)).

• Hilton Worldwide:  
  – Curio Collection – an upper‑upscale lifestyle soft brand for distinct hotels and resorts ([hoteldevelopmentguide.com](https://hoteldevelopmentguide.com/hotel-brands/?utm_source=openai)).  
  – Tapestry Collection – another Hilton soft brand, generally positioned slightly below Curio but still focused on unique, independent-style hotels ([hospitalitas.com.mx](https://hospitalitas.com.mx/2022/07/28/entendiendo-el-modelo-de-negocio-de-las-soft-brands-hoteleras/?utm_source=openai)).

• Hyatt Hotels:  
  – Unbound Collection – Hyatt’s soft brand for independent lifestyle properties, offering creative conversion flexibility ([hospitalitas.com.mx](https://hospitalitas.com.mx/2022/07/28/entendiendo-el-modelo-de-negocio-de-las-soft-brands-hoteleras/?utm_source=openai)).

• IHG (InterContinental Hotels Group):  
  – Vignette Collection – a flexible, upscale-to-upper-upscale soft brand specifically aimed at conversions ([hoteldevelopmentguide.com](https://hoteldevelopmentguide.com/hotel-brands/?utm_source=openai)).

• Wyndham Hotels & Resorts:  
  – Trademark Collection – an upscale soft brand for independent hotels; broad in reach ([hoteldevelopmentguide.com](https://hoteldevelopmentguide.com/hotel-brands/?utm_source=openai)).  
  – Registry Collection – a higher-end soft brand under Wyndham, for more luxury-oriented conversions ([hoteldevelopmentguide.com](https://hoteldevelopmentguide.com/hotel-brands/?utm_source=openai)).

• Choice Hotels International:  
  – Ascend Hotel Collection – one of the earliest global soft brands, targeting boutique, historic, or resort hotels; present in Mexico ([media.choicehotels.com](https://media.choicehotels.com/ascend-hotel-collection-press-kit/1000?utm_source=openai)).

• Other notable soft-brand operators active in Mexico and Latin America include:  
  – Preferred Hotels & Resorts – U.S.–based, focuses on independent luxury and lifestyle hotels ([hospitalitas.com.mx](https://hospitalitas.com.mx/2022/07/28/entendiendo-el-modelo-de-negocio-de-las-soft-brands-hoteleras/?utm_source=openai)).  
  – Oyo – originating in India, targets independent mid‑level and economy properties and is active in Mexico ([hospitalitas.com.mx](https://hospitalitas.com.mx/2022/07/28/entendiendo-el-modelo-de-negocio-de-las-soft-brands-hoteleras/?utm_source=openai)).  
  – Dot Hotels – an Argentine soft-brand operator for independent hotels across various market levels ([hospitalitas.com.mx](https://hospitalitas.com.mx/2022/07/28/entendiendo-el-modelo-de-negocio-de-las-soft-brands-hoteleras/?utm_source=openai)).  
  – Gamma (Posadas) – a Mexican soft brand by Grupo Posadas, which provides a soft-brand-like affiliation model ([hospitalitas.com.mx](https://hospitalitas.com.mx/2022/07/28/entendiendo-el-modelo-de-negocio-de-las-soft-brands-hoteleras/?utm_source=openai)).

In summary, owners in Mexico evaluating a conversion to a soft‑brand model typically look at a spectrum of collection brands spanning global operators—Marriott (Autograph, Tribute, Design Hotels, Luxury Collection), Hilton (Curio, Tapestry), Hyatt (Unbound), IHG (Vignette), Wyndham (Trademark, Registry), and Choice (Ascend)—alongside regional or independent groups such as Preferred, Oyo, Dot Hotels, and Mexico‑based Gamma. Each brand offers varying degrees of conversion flexibility, marketing reach, service standards, and loyalty integration, which owners weigh against the property’s unique identity and target positioning.
